title: classification_metadata.failed_attempts counts events that never produced a compose, and chronically-stuck escalation ke
description:
classification_metadata.failed_attempts counts events that never produced a compose, and chronically-stuck escalation keys on that counter, so narrowed child gaps are minted from attempts that did not happen.

MEASURED 2026-09-11 on gap no-check-asks-whether-a-learning-store-is-empty-against-a-non-empty-input. The counter read 2, then 4, then 6 across the session. Querying execution for traces carrying that gap_id returns exactly ONE compose trace, at 2026-09-10T22:12:38, which is also the only recorded failure_lesson. Attempts 3 through 6 produced no execution row at all.

CORROBORATING MECHANISM. The dispatch path logs 'gap-compose unit NOT started for <id> — a compose is already in flight' and drops the nudge without queueing it; 474 such skips were recorded across 159 distinct gaps in 24 hours. A gap whose dispatch is skipped has not been attempted, but the counter does not distinguish a skipped dispatch from a failed compose. The LLM plane was also unavailable for 12 hours, during which dispatches failed at endpoint discovery before any drafter ran; those are likewise not attempts at the work.

CONSEQUENCE. The counter is an input to escalation: at a threshold the gap is classified chronically stuck and a narrowed child is emitted. On the gap above, a narrowed child was minted while only one real compose had ever occurred. Narrowed children inherit the parent's instruction, so a parent that was never genuinely attempted spawns copies on the strength of phantom failures. Separately, failure_lessons does not keep pace with the counter: 6 attempts against 1 recorded lesson, so the diagnostic for later attempts is absent even when they are real.

PREDICATE FOR CLOSURE: for a gap created after the fix, classification_metadata.failed_attempts equals the number of execution rows carrying that gap_id. Verify by filing a fresh gap, allowing a dispatch to be skipped by the in-flight guard, and confirming the counter does not advance for the skipped dispatch.
